diamond.atoms: C at (3a/8,3a/8,3a/8) and (5a/8,5a/8,5a/8) Angstrom; aligns with COD 2101499 symmetry-expanded sites

conversion_steps: crystal_data.py reads original CUBE values in e/Bohr^3, converts origin/axes/embedded atom coordinates to Angstrom using 0.529177210903 Angstrom/Bohr, preserves scalar values without rescaling, and writes derived VTI. CIF expansion writes derived VTP. Original files remain unchanged.
